about: Pages and screens the accessibility tests open. Add each one in the same change that builds it. url is a path on A11Y_BASE_URL (Power Pages) or a full address. type is page (default), canvas or model-driven. auth: true needs a saved sign-in from npm run test:a11y:login. waitFor is text that appears once the page or screen has loaded. skip can list checks to leave out (reflow, focus) with a reason in reasonSkipped.

examples.name: Power Pages: start page
examples.waitFor: <text that shows once the page has loaded, such as its heading>
